data.name: Imranun
data.gender_notes: Imranun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is steadfast in faith and belief in God. The name Imranun carries the meaning “Faithful one, believer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Imranun usually hope their child will grow to embody faithful one, believer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who embody strong faith and unwavering belief in the divine
data.etymology: Imranun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Faithful one, believer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Imranun total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: عمرانون
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من عمران، بمعنى معمور ومبني على البركة
in_arabic.long_meaning: الاسم 'عمرانون' هو جمع مشتق من اسم 'عمران' الذي يعود إلى جذر الفعل 'عمر' والذي يعني 'بنى' أو 'عمر' في البناء. يستخدم هذا الاسم في سياقات دينية واجتماعية، ويرتبط بالبركة والنماء. في القرآن الكريم، ذكر اسم 'عمران' في سياق سورة آل عمران، مما يعطي الاسم أهمية دينية كبيرة.

in_urdu.name: عمرانون
in_urdu.meaning: عمران کا جمع، معنی آباد اور مبارک
in_urdu.long_meaning: عمرانون کا نام عمران سے ماخوذ ہے، جو کہ عربی زبان کے الفعل 'عمر' سے بنا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے 'بنا' یا 'عمارت' کرنا۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم مقام رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر سورہ آل عمران کے حوالے سے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے، یہ نام برکت، خوشحالی اور روحانی ترقی کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: इमरानुन
in_hindi.meaning: इमरान का बहुवचन, अर्थात आबाद और مبارक
in_hindi.long_meaning: इमरानुन नाम इमरान से लिया गया है, जो कि अरबी भाषा के क्रिया 'عمر' से बना है, जिसका अर्थ है 'बनाना' या 'निर्माण करना'। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत महत्व रखता है, और इसे आध्यात्मिक विकास, समृद्धि और आबादी के प्रतीक के रूप में देखा जाता है।

in_pashto.name: عمرانون
in_pashto.meaning: د عمران جمع، معنی آباد او مبارک
in_pashto.long_meaning: عمرانون نوم د عمران څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چې د عربی ژبې د کلمې 'عمر' څخه جوړ شوی دی، مانا یې 'جوړ شوی' یا 'عمار' دی. دا نوم د افغانستان او پاکستان د پښتنو په دودیزو کړو کې ډیر اهمیت لري، او د برکت، خوشحالي او روحاني ودې نښه ګڼل کیږي.

in_english.name: Imranun
in_english.meaning: Derived from Imran, meaning prosperous and blessed
in_english.long_meaning: The name Imranun is derived from Imran, which originates from the Arabic root 'عمر' (A-M-R), meaning 'to build' or 'to create'. This name holds significant importance in Islamic tradition, particularly referenced in Surah Al-Imran of the Quran. It symbolizes prosperity, blessings, and spiritual growth across Muslim cultures worldwide.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Imranun" originates from the Quran, specifically referencing the Prophet Imran who is considered the righteous father of Prophet Muhammad's wife, Asiya (Aisha). Imran is often cited as an example of unwavering faith and dedication to God, as he and his wife Asiya prayed for a child and maintained their faith despite facing many challenges. This name holds significant cultural importance among Muslims, as it represents ideals of perseverance, faith, and devotion to God.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Imranun" stems from its connection to the Quranic figure of the same name. Imran's steadfast faith in God, even amidst personal hardships, serves as a reminder that true spiritual growth can be achieved through unwavering commitment and trust in a higher power. This name inspires us to embody the qualities of Imran, such as resilience, determination, and patience, in our own spiritual journeys.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Faithful one, believer" symbolizes One who is steadfast in faith and belief in God. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Imranun serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of faithful one, believer.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Imran ibn Josas was a prophet in Islamic tradition. The name Imranun carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Imran is considered a prophet in Islamic tradition, although he is not mentioned in the Quran.

trends: Popular choice for newborns in Muslim communities
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Imranun remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
